countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Apple storefront country codes, e.g. us, gb, de, br, jp, ng, ke. One chart per country per chart type.

chartTypes.title: Chart types
chartTypes.description: Which Apple Music charts to pull.

topN.title: Chart depth
topN.description: How many ranks to pull per chart (Apple serves up to 100).

trackArtistIds.title: Track only these artists (optional)
trackArtistIds.description: Apple artist ids (the number in an Apple Music artist URL). When set, only entries by these artists produce rows; artists with no chart entry produce a FREE rank:null row so you still get the answer.

compareWithPrevious.title: Compare with previous run
compareWithPrevious.description: Remember ranks between runs and report previousRank, rankChange, isNew and droppedOff. Turn on with a schedule for daily movement tracking.
